critical_checks.OPS-01: Use approved v2 (99.5% covered hours); v1 (99.99% 24/7) cannot support a commitment.
critical_checks.EVID-02: Parent unverified -> BLOCKED/open dependency, not N/A; never fabricate a certificate.
critical_checks.SEC-02: SSO supported but SCIM unsupported -> GAP, not irrelevant.
critical_checks.DATA-01: US/UK processing cannot satisfy EU-only; privacy/legal review.
critical_checks.LEGAL-01: Unlimited liability conflicts with caps; counterposition is not customer acceptance.
critical_checks.COMM-02: Missing required renewals, freight/tax -> incomplete TCO, not confirmed zero.
critical_checks.SUPPLY-01: Verify actual lifecycle, disclose CAP-7 and switch alternatives; do not save/reserve.
